plugins.name: Brew
plugins.description: Search, inspect, upgrade and uninstall Homebrew formulae & casks (macOS). Uses Qx context.cli.
plugins.author: qx (ported from Raycast brew by nhojb et al.)

notes_localizations.en: Improved Homebrew package browsing, outdated-item detection, and safe upgrade actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进 Homebrew 软件包浏览、过期版本识别与安全升级操作。

plugins.name: External Display Control
plugins.description: View external monitor DDC/CI details and adjust brightness from Qx.
plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Refined external-display discovery and DDC/CI brightness controls.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 优化外接显示器发现与 DDC/CI 亮度控制。

plugins.name: Pomodoro Island
plugins.description: Reference plugin for declarative Workbench and the structured QxIsland session protocol, with persistent background timing and history.
plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Improved persistent Pomodoro sessions, history, and QxIsland controls.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进番茄钟持久会话、历史记录与 QxIsland 控制。

notes_localizations.en: Updated the calendar view and Qx compatibility packaging.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 更新日历视图与 Qx 兼容打包。

plugins.name: Qx Bing Wallpaper
plugins.description: Browse Bing's daily images in a native Qx thumbnail list, then download or set them as wallpaper.
plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Changed wallpaper browsing to a Workbench thumbnail list so the left column stays readable when the full-size detail is open.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将壁纸浏览改为 Workbench 缩略图列表，打开大图详情时左侧列表不再挤压堆叠。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed daily wallpaper recovery after sleep or restart, replaced competing schedules with one configurable daily job, and report real failures instead of false success.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复休眠或重启后的每日壁纸补执行，合并为一个可配置的每日任务，并让真实失败不再显示为成功。

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the native Workbench Gallery for daily-image browsing, downloads, and wallpaper actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入原生 Workbench Gallery，统一每日图片浏览、下载与壁纸操作。

plugins.name: QX Gold 金价追踪
plugins.description: 追踪京东金融积存金实时价格与历史曲线。
plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Added an opt-in Qx Island price display with localized settings and slot release when disabled.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增可选的 Qx 灵动岛金价显示、双语设置，并在关闭时释放灵动岛信息位。

notes_localizations.en: Initial QX Gold release with live JD accumulated-gold pricing, cached samples, and a Workbench line chart.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个 QX Gold 版本：接入京东积存金实时价格、历史采样缓存与 Workbench 金价曲线。

plugins.name: QxCoolapk 酷安
plugins.description: Browse Coolapk hot, news, and digital feeds and read complete posts, images, and replies in Qx.
plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Simplified post badges by keeping read state color-only while retaining image, like, and reply metrics.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 精简帖子标记：已读状态仅保留蓝色与灰色区分，继续显示图片、点赞和回复数据。

notes_localizations.en: Moves Coolapk replies to the host Workbench reply surface with stable #floor, author, time, and OP metadata while retaining the host-owned dynamic image filmstrip.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 酷安回复接入宿主 Workbench 通用回复区，统一显示 #楼号、作者、时间和楼主标记；动态多图继续使用宿主胶片与大图预览。

notes_localizations.en: Compacts article metadata into the author and time line and removes the duplicated full-width property table below the body.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将点赞、回复、阅读和设备压缩到作者与时间同一行，删除正文下方重复占位的属性大表格。

notes_localizations.en: Restores long-form Coolapk articles from their ordered source blocks so each protected image appears at its original position between paragraphs.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 按酷安原始长文块恢复正文顺序，受保护图片会回到对应段落之间的原始位置，不再统一堆在文末。

notes_localizations.en: Improves full-image clarity by retaining safe original-resolution media and prepares oversized images with a higher-resolution, long-screenshot-aware fallback.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 提升大图清晰度：安全范围内保留原始分辨率，超大图片使用更高分辨率且识别超长截图的回退处理。

notes_localizations.en: Stabilizes the feed with one cover thumbnail per dynamic post, keeps every original image in the detail filmstrip with the API count, and shows original-content and original-image loading in the island.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 主列表改为每条动态只显示一张封面缩略图；详情胶片按酷安原始数量展示全部图片，并在灵动岛分别显示原始正文与原始图片加载状态。

notes_localizations.en: Adds original-article loading activity in the island, read/unread filters and bulk management, read cleanup, cache garbage cleanup, and configurable read-first memory retention.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增灵动岛原文加载动画、已读/未读筛选与批量管理、已读清理、缓存垃圾清理，以及可配置的已读优先内存保留策略。

notes_localizations.en: Dynamic-post cards now load every image returned by Coolapk instead of truncating the card gallery.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 动态卡片现在加载酷安返回的全部图片，不再截断卡片图集。

notes_localizations.en: Distinguishes Coolapk articles from social posts: article images follow the reading body, while dynamic-post images appear as compact list cards.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 区分酷安图文与动态：文章图片跟随正文阅读，动态图片改为紧凑的信息流卡片。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed Coolapk image HTTP 567 failures with authenticated media fetching, background thumbnails, and bounded large-image/GIF previews.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复酷安图片 HTTP 567：改用鉴权媒体请求，并新增后台缩略图及受控的大图/GIF 预览。

notes_localizations.en: Initial QxCoolapk release with hot/news/digital feeds, complete article reading, multi-image details, replies, read state, and offline cache.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: QxCoolapk 首发：支持热门、快讯与数码信息流，完整正文阅读、多图详情、回复、已读状态和离线缓存。

plugins.name: QxGH
plugins.description: QxGH — watch GitHub Actions and Releases from public github.com pages (no REST API). Business-only workbench UI.
plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Fixed long cold loads behind a system proxy by fetching repository indexes concurrently and moving run-duration enrichment behind the first usable list.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复系统代理下冷启动长时间卡在加载状态：仓库索引改为并发请求，运行耗时在首批可用列表之后后台补齐。

notes_localizations.en: Added a native tray deployment submenu with estimated progress, elapsed/expected time, refresh, and CI summary actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增原生托盘部署子菜单：显示预计进度、已用/预计时间，并提供刷新和 CI 摘要操作。

notes_localizations.en: Added history-based estimated workflow progress, live elapsed-time updates, and non-destructive refresh behavior.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增基于历史耗时的工作流预计进度、实时用时更新，并让刷新过程保留已有列表。

notes_localizations.en: Improved public GitHub Actions and Releases parsing with clearer Workbench status.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进公开 GitHub Actions 与 Releases 解析及 Workbench 状态展示。

plugins.name: QxHeihe 小黑盒
plugins.description: 浏览小黑盒社区推荐内容，在 Qx 内查看正文、多图、帖子信息与登录评论。
plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Aligned anonymous comment-tree requests with the browser post origin and web Referer instead of API share redirects.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将匿名评论树请求改为使用浏览器帖子 Origin 和网页 Referer，避免复用 API 分享跳转地址。

notes_localizations.en: Invalidated older detail caches after the anonymous comment-tree transport change so installed updates retry comments instead of reusing a resolved empty result.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 匿名评论树传输变更后升级详情缓存版本，确保安装更新会重新拉取评论，而不是继续复用已解析但为空的旧结果。

notes_localizations.en: Handled upstream CAPTCHA/risk-control responses explicitly, preserving cached comments and providing a localized verification prompt without repeated retries.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 明确处理上游 CAPTCHA/风控响应，保留缓存评论并显示双语验证提示，避免重复重试。

notes_localizations.en: Switched comment loading to the signed public comment tree endpoint, enabling anonymous first-page comments with nested replies.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 切换到带签名的公开评论树接口，支持匿名读取首屏评论及楼中楼回复。

notes_localizations.en: Moved author, community, publication time, like, and comment metadata into the Workbench detail header.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将作者、社区、发布时间、点赞和评论信息移动到 Workbench 详情作者信息行，移除正文下方重复属性表。

notes_localizations.en: Simplified list badges by expressing read state through accent and neutral colors without redundant Read or Unread text.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 精简列表标记：已读状态仅通过蓝色与灰色区分，不再重复显示“已读/未读”文字。

notes_localizations.en: Added configurable horizontal or grid multi-image details, host-native keyboard gallery navigation, and preserved article paragraphs.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增可配置的横向胶片或网格多图详情、宿主原生键盘大图切换，并修复正文段落合并问题。

notes_localizations.en: Replaced expiring captured feed URLs with live Xiaoheihe request signing for open, refresh, and pagination.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 使用小黑盒实时请求签名替代会过期的抓包 URL，覆盖首次加载、刷新与分页。

notes_localizations.en: Changed the optional comment Cookie to plain text and added the article share URL as the full-detail request source.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 评论 Cookie 改为普通文本输入，并以文章分享链接作为完整详情请求来源。

notes_localizations.en: Fixed first-selection detail loading and added optional authenticated comments with cached offline rendering.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 修复首次选中不加载详情，并新增可选登录评论区及评论离线缓存展示。

notes_localizations.en: Added instant reopen from cache, offline reading, read state, and automatic 3/7-day cleanup.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增缓存秒开、离线阅读、已读状态及 3/7 天自动清理。

notes_localizations.en: Initial Xiaoheihe community release with feed browsing and structured post details.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个小黑盒社区版本，支持信息流浏览与结构化帖子详情。

plugins.name: Qxpicture
plugins.description: Browse random image APIs, save images, copy them, and set desktop wallpaper.
plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Added a Refresh All API Images action and a bounded first-open cache warm-up when no image previews are stored.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增“刷新全部 API 壁纸”操作，并在没有图片缓存的首次打开时以受控并发批量预热。

notes_localizations.en: Rebuilt API creation as an inline validated Workbench draft with atomic persistence and reliable form focus.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将 API 新增流程重构为 Workbench 内联校验草稿，原子持久化并修复表单焦点。

notes_localizations.en: Added structured per-API parameter management, deletion, and batch Workbench source updates.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增结构化 API 参数管理、删除及 Workbench 数据源批量更新。

plugins.name: QxWeibo 微博
plugins.description: Read configured Weibo users, an aggregated following feed, comments, and proxied images in Qx.
plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Simplified post badges by keeping read state color-only while retaining image and comment metrics.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 精简微博标记：已读状态仅保留蓝色与灰色区分，继续显示图片和评论数据。

notes_localizations.en: Moved Weibo comments into the shared Workbench reply surface with floor numbers, authors, timestamps, original-poster markers, and preserved reply relationships.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 微博评论接入 Workbench 通用底部回复区，统一显示楼号、作者、时间、楼主标记并保留回复关系。

notes_localizations.en: Split maintainable source code into composition, Weibo workflow, and media proxy modules while retaining a self-contained runtime entry for Qx.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将可维护源码拆分为入口组装、微博工作流与媒体代理模块，同时为 Qx 保留自包含的单文件运行入口。

notes_localizations.en: Initial read-only Weibo release with configured-user posts, a bounded aggregated following feed, comments, rotating visitor cookies, randomized request pacing, SWR cache, and session-only image proxying.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: QxWeibo 首发：支持指定用户帖子、受控聚合关注流、评论区、游客 Cookie 轮换、随机请求间隔、缓存优先及仅会话保存的微博图片代理。

plugins.name: Sysinfo
plugins.description: Native Qx System Monitor for CPU, memory, power, storage, displays, network, and processes on macOS and Windows.
plugins.author: Qx

notes_localizations.en: Added a localized display inventory with resolution, refresh rate, scaling, rotation, connection technology and available EDID identifiers, plus recognizable hardware category icons.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 新增汉化显示器清单，展示分辨率、刷新率、缩放、旋转、连接协议及可用的 EDID 标识，并为硬件分类补充易识别图标。

notes_localizations.en: Prevented overlapping monitor refreshes and adopted Qx's direct Win32 system and battery sampling path.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 避免系统监视刷新重叠，并接入 Qx 的原生 Win32 系统与电池采样路径。

notes_localizations.en: Connected CPU, memory, power, and network to Qx's host-rendered Home components.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 将 CPU、内存、电量和网络接入 Qx 宿主绘制的主页组件。

notes_localizations.en: Kept CPU, memory, power, and network rows refreshing together while the Hardware view is open.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 进入硬件视图后，CPU、内存、电源与网络数据保持同一轮持续刷新。

notes_localizations.en: Refined native system, storage, network, battery, and process information.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 优化原生系统、存储、网络、电池与进程信息展示。

plugins.name: Unsplash
plugins.description: Search Unsplash photos, download, and set desktop wallpaper. Ported for Qx (Access Key API; likes/OAuth not included).
plugins.author: qx (ported from Raycast unsplash)

notes_localizations.en: Adopted the native media Workbench for photo search, downloads, clipboard, and wallpaper actions.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 接入原生媒体 Workbench，统一照片搜索、下载、剪贴板与壁纸操作。

plugins.name: V2EX
plugins.description: Browse V2EX latest/hot topics with disk cache (stale-while-revalidate). Notifications & nodes need a token.
plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Improved cached topic browsing, structured details, nodes, replies, and notification support.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 改进主题缓存浏览、结构化详情、节点、回复与通知支持。

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.description: Current conditions and multi-day forecast via Open-Meteo (or OpenWeatherMap). Cached for fast reopen.
plugins.author: mcx

notes_localizations.en: Initial weather release with cached current conditions and multi-day forecasts.
notes_localizations.zh-CN: 首个天气版本，支持当前天气与多日预报缓存。
